title: Demand and ETR Forecasting at Airports
why: Uber's own airports team forecasts demand because too few drivers means riders struggle to get a ride, and too many means drivers sit idle.

title: Taxi and Limousine Commission passes new rules protecting app drivers from lockouts
why: New York's regulator voted rules on when apps may cut off driver access, after drivers alleged lockouts lowered their pay. How many drivers work, and when, is a live issue in this city.

title: Real-Time Spatial Temporal Forecasting @ Lyft
why: Lyft's engineers describe forecasts behind decisions from real-time rider pricing and driver incentives to budget planning, and look at how simple classical time-series models do the job in real time.
